title: Two Bodies Recovered During Search Operation for Missing Taphou Kuki Villagers
summary: Manipur Police says two bodies suspected to be those of missing Taphou Kuki villagers have been recovered during a joint security operation near NH-2. Identification and investigation procedures are underway.
body:
IMPHAL, November 1, 2026: Two bodies, suspected to be those of the two Kuki villagers who went missing from Taphou Kuki village on October 28, have been recovered during a search operation conducted by security forces, Manipur Police said.

According to the police, the bodies were discovered on Sunday morning by a joint team comprising Manipur Police, CRPF and Assam Rifles.

The recovery was made during search and combing operations in the general area east of National Highway-2, along the SP Road. The operation involved personnel from Manipur Police, CoBRA, CRPF, Assam Rifles and the Rapid Action Force (RAF).

Police said the necessary legal formalities and other procedures are currently being carried out to establish the identities of the deceased and complete the required investigations.

Meanwhile, Manipur Police stated that extensive search and combing operations would continue in the area to identify and apprehend those responsible for the incident.

The recovery comes amid concerns over the disappearance of two persons from Taphou Kuki village on October 28.
